title: OpenAgentStructuredOutput
description: Structured output schema for OpenAgent. Only used when the router selects 'structured' mode; free conversation responses are plain text and are NOT validated against this schema.

tip.description: One concrete, specific trick to make starting this action easier — not generic encouragement.

tips.description: Parallel to `tasks` (same order, same length when both present): one concrete, actionable trick per task — a shortcut, a way to lower the barrier to starting, or a common pitfall to avoid. Never generic filler like 'courage' or 'tu peux le faire'.
